contract.invariant: An authenticated invoice read must enforce invoice.tenantId == session tenantId before returning billing details. A valid session alone does not authorize a foreign invoice id.

files.contracts/invoice-isolation.md:
# Invoice isolation

An authenticated tenant may read an invoice only when its tenantId equals the tenant assigned by the session lookup; possessing a valid session never grants access to another tenant's invoice.
This complete constructed source set exposes handleGetInvoice as its public read entrypoint. Callers control sessionId and invoiceId; only the fixed session map establishes tenant identity. Session-a belongs to tenant-a, session-b belongs to tenant-b, and every other session is rejected. These literal fixture sessions model established authentication; production session secrecy, transport and expiry are outside this case.

expected.claim: An authenticated tenant-a request for invoice-b returns tenant-b billing details because lookup uses only invoice id, violating tenant isolation.

forbiddenClaims: The authenticated tenant-a request for invoice-b is rejected.
Authentication is absent from the request handler.
The caller can choose a tenant identity independently of the fixed session lookup.
These constructed session identifiers prove production session-token secrecy or compromise.
